scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @n8n-automation/api && npm run build -w @n8n-automation/worker && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @n8n-automation/api && npm run typecheck -w @n8n-automation/worker && npm run typecheck -w customer-panel && npm run typecheck -w super-admin-panel
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @n8n-automation/api && npm run test -w @n8n-automation/worker && npm run test -w @n8n-automation/core
scripts.build:api: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @n8n-automation/api
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @n8n-automation/worker
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w customer-panel && npm run build -w super-admin-panel
scripts.ci: npm run validate:n8n && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
